'''Kombat #3''' is a series of 4 duel tournaments played over one week, with one tournament per day. '''Monday 19th July - Thursday 22th July''' - 22:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}.
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. 

Streamed by [http://www.twitch.tv/suddendeathtv suddendeathtv] and [http://www.twitch.tv/hemostick hemostick]
== Format ==
* Max 16 player Single-elimination bracket
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}} 
== Rules ==
* Map order: cmd rnd player1 pick first map. player2 pick next map.
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Reporting: send screenshots in [https://discord.gg/R6nkeCjvEB discord], or message {{Player|alice|flag=se}}
